summary: Verified multi-turn Visible Interpretation shading on the '?preview=writing' student flow. Submitted an assignment, a first draft, and three consecutive revisions (4 total AI turns). On every turn the working-unit region [data-testid=vi-active-region] was present with a non-zero bounding box and dynamic uppercase label 'ELABORATION'. The shaded region tracked the growing draft (heights 237px -> 309px -> 381px -> 381px across turns), confirming the whitespace-tolerant + first/last-sentence-anchor locator (locateSpanLoose / locateUnit) keeps matching as the unit lengthens. The bug reported by the user ('Compass stops shading the unit it is working on across iterations') is NOT reproducible with the current fix.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicPreview.jsx is ~1332 lines — consider splitting the Visible Interpretation overlay (regions, ranges, portion logic) into its own component/hook for maintainability.

vi-thesis-region only appears when focus is Thesis OR the thesis snippet is located; in this run Compass stayed on ELABORATION for all 4 turns so vi-thesis-region was consistently null. This is spec-correct (thesis is handled separately) but worth documenting so downstream tests don't flag its absence as a regression.
seed_data_creation: None; used ephemeral session started from ?preview=writing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-turn shading persistence confirmed across 4 turns (draft + 3 revisions). Per-turn state: Turn1 active=ELABORATION w=543 h=237; Turn2 w=543 h=309; Turn3 w=544 h=381; Turn4 w=544 h=381. Send button becomes enabled only when draft.trim() && dirty && !busy — always wait until innerText != 'Reading…' before clicking. AI turn takes ~28-38s per revision on this environment. Textarea data-testid='preview-document' is the source of truth for draft; overlay lives in sibling data-testid='preview-document-highlight'.
rca of the issue: Reported bug (working unit un-shades across iterations) was RCA'd to a brittle exact-substring locator that broke once the paragraph grew / was re-wrapped by the engine. Fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/thesisMatch.js introduces locateSpanLoose (whitespace-tolerant compare) with a first+last-sentence anchor fallback and token fallback; interpretationRegions in PublicPreview.jsx now emits a single contiguous vi-region-active per turn. Verified working across 3 consecutive revisions.
